plain.li: I spend a third of my life in that room. It can have {THING}.
Nothing big. Just {THING}, so the room stops feeling borrowed.
There's been an empty corner in my room for weeks. I've marked it out for {THING}.
[touch:plantpot] My room smells like boots and old sweat. A plant might help.
[touch:light] Every night I find my bed by memory and bruised shins. I'd like a light.
[touch:endtable] I keep putting my things on the floor and then stepping on them. I've marked a spot by the bed.
[touch:dresser] Everything I own lives in a heap at the foot of my bed, and {THING} would give it somewhere to go.
[skill:Plants,touch:plantpot] I grow food for the rest of you all day. This one's just for me.
[trait:NightOwl,touch:light] I'm up all night anyway. I'd like to see what I'm doing.
[winter] Long winter ahead, and I'll spend half of it in that room. It's getting {THING}.
[afterraid] We nearly lost everything this week. I want something in my room that's worth keeping.
[poor] I know we're scraping by, but {THING} barely costs anything. I checked.
[newcomer] If I'm staying, my room should look lived in, and {THING} is a start.
[trait:Greedy] I've seen the other rooms. Mine's getting {THING}, to start with.
[skill:Artistic] My room's a blank canvas. I'm starting with {THING} and working outward.
[lowmood] I need something in that room besides four walls and bad dreams.
[child] I want {THING} in my room, a real one! I drew where it goes.
[old] At my age I'm done waiting for the right moment to fix up my room.
I'd like my room to look like someone cares about it, starting with {THING}.

warm.li: Would anyone mind if my room got {THING}? I've marked a spot where it won't be in anyone's way.
I've planned {THING} for my room, whenever someone has a spare hour. There's no rush.
[touch:plantpot] I'd like to look after something small for a change. A plant seems like a good start.
[touch:light] I like to read before sleep when there's time. A light would save my eyes.
[touch:endtable] Somewhere beside the bed for a cup of water and a keepsake or two, if someone has the time.
[touch:dresser] I'd love a place to fold things properly. It's how I was raised.
[touch:plantpot] Something green by my window would be lovely, if no one minds.
[touch:light] A light by my bed, so I can mend things in the evening without keeping anyone up.
[touch:endtable] Just a table by my bed, since I've been keeping my cup on the windowsill.
[touch:dresser] I'd like a dresser, so my things stop spilling out into the hall.

blunt.li: My room, my corner, my {THINGBARE}. Any questions?
Blueprint's down. If anyone cancels it, I'll find out who.
[touch:plantpot] Yes, I want a plant. Don't look at me like that.
[touch:light] I've stubbed every toe I own in that room. I want a light.
[touch:endtable] I need somewhere to put things that isn't the floor or my boots.
[touch:dresser] My clothes have been on the floor long enough.
[touch:plantpot] I'm getting a plant. Don't water it for me.
[touch:light] Dark room. Want a light. Blueprint's down.
[touch:endtable] Table by the bed. That's all.
[touch:dresser] I want drawers, because my clothes are on the floor.

cheerful.li: I've marked a spot for {THING}! My room is finally going to feel like mine.
I'm decorating my room! It's the nicest job I've had all season.
[touch:plantpot] A plant pot! I'm going to talk to it every morning.
[touch:light] A light in my room! I'll finally see what color the walls are.
[touch:endtable] A bedside table! Somewhere to put my cup at night, like a civilized person.
[touch:dresser] Real drawers! I can lose my socks in an organized way now.
[touch:plantpot] My plant's getting a name before it's even in the soil!
[touch:light] My very own light! I'll read in bed every night.
[touch:endtable] A table for my bedside, for my cup and my lucky stone!
[touch:dresser] A dresser! My good shirt finally gets a drawer of its own.

gloomy.li: I'll probably be dead before anyone builds it, but I've marked out {THING} anyway.
Maybe if the room looks lived-in, I'll feel like I live there.
[touch:plantpot] I'd like one living thing in that room besides me.
[touch:light] The dark in my room is starting to feel like company. I'd rather have a light.
[touch:endtable] A table by the bed, for the water cup and the long nights.
[touch:dresser] Somewhere to keep my things. It'll be easier for whoever clears out my room.
[touch:plantpot] Something green in my room. It might outlast me.
[touch:light] A light, for the nights when I can't sleep.
[touch:endtable] A table by the bed, since I'm awake in the night often enough to need one.
[touch:dresser] My clothes on the floor make the room feel like a cell. A dresser might help.

cold.li: My room has an unused wall. I've assigned it {THING}.
I sleep better with {THING} in the room, and I work better when I've slept.
[touch:plantpot] I'm told plants calm people. I'll test it on myself first.
[touch:light] I lose minutes every night looking for things in the dark. A light gets them back.
[touch:endtable] An end table keeps everything I need within reach of the bed.
[touch:dresser] Clothes last longer folded than heaped. A dresser is just maintenance.
[touch:plantpot] A plant improves a room at very little cost. I've marked the spot.
[touch:light] Reading in the evening requires a light. I've planned one.
[touch:endtable] I've measured the space by my bed, and an end table fits exactly.
[touch:dresser] My belongings need sorting. A dresser does that.

plain.li: My room looks like a person lives in it now.
It's a small thing, but it's my small thing.
[touch:plantpot] There's dirt in a pot in my room, and I'm unreasonably pleased about it.
[touch:light] First night with a light in my room, and I didn't trip over a single thing.
[touch:endtable] My cup sits on the new table at night now, instead of the floor.
[touch:dresser] My clothes are folded away and I can see the floor again.
[night] Lay awake looking at it, which beat lying awake looking at nothing.
[lowmood] It helps more than I thought it would.
[old] That's how a room should look, and I've lived in enough of them to know.
[child] Come and see my room, come and see, there's a {THINGBARE} in it now!
[trait:Greedy] Lovely, so what's next for my room?
It's only one {THINGBARE}, but it changes the whole room.

warm.li: Thank you to whoever built it; I know it was extra work on top of everything else.
[touch:plantpot] I watered it already, probably too much, but it looks happy.
[touch:light] I read a whole chapter last night without squinting once.
[touch:dresser] Everything folded and put away, the way it should be in a home.
I'll thank whoever built it properly at supper.

blunt.li: It's in, it's mine, and it stays where it is.
About time, and it's not even crooked.
[touch:light] Finally a light, and now I can see how dusty everything is.
[touch:endtable] Good, my things have somewhere to go besides the floor.
Good, that's done.

cheerful.li: My new {THINGBARE} is perfect and I've already shown it to three people!
[touch:plantpot] It's growing, or at least the dirt looks very ambitious!
[touch:light] Light in my room whenever I want it, like royalty!
[touch:dresser] Every drawer has something in it already!
I keep finding excuses to go back to my room and look at it!

gloomy.li: Pretty enough, for a room I mostly lie awake in.
It doesn't fix anything, but it's nice to look at.
[touch:plantpot] The plant is doing better than I am.
[touch:endtable] Nice table; it'll hold my things just fine after I'm gone.
I'll give it this much, it doesn't wobble.

cold.li: Installed as planned; the room is measurably better.
Acceptable work; I've noted who did it.
[touch:light] I can see the door from my bed now, which was the point.
[touch:dresser] Everything I own is now sorted and accounted for.
Completed, and in the right place.

plain.li: {PAWN_nameDef} asked how long "{AMBITION}" would take, and didn't like the answer.
{PAWN_nameDef} wanted to know who would actually do the hauling for "{AMBITION}", and got no volunteers.
{PAWN_nameDef} sat with folded arms through all of {OTHER_nameDef}'s pitch.
{PAWN_nameDef} asked whether anyone had measured anything, or whether "{AMBITION}" was more of a feeling.
{PAWN_nameDef} muttered something about "{AMBITION}" into {PAWN_possessive} cup and refused to repeat it.
{PAWN_nameDef} kept asking questions about "{AMBITION}" until {OTHER_nameDef} looked ready to throw a chair.
[poor] {PAWN_nameDef} asked where the materials for "{AMBITION}" were supposed to come from, since the stockpile was mostly rocks.
[afterraid] {PAWN_nameDef} pointed out that the dead raiders were still lying outside, and said "{AMBITION}" could wait until they were buried.
[winter] {PAWN_nameDef} said "{AMBITION}" sounded like a fine idea for spring.
[night] {PAWN_nameDef} yawned through most of {OTHER_nameDef}'s pitch, but woke up in time to argue with it.
[trait:Greedy] {PAWN_nameDef} asked what {PAWN_pronoun} would personally get out of "{AMBITION}", and wasn't satisfied with "not much."
[trait:Jealous] {PAWN_nameDef} listened to {OTHER_nameDef} pitch "{AMBITION}" with the face of someone who'd had the same idea a week ago.
[trait:Gourmand] {PAWN_nameDef} asked whether "{AMBITION}" would mean better food, and lost interest when it wouldn't.
[trait:Pyromaniac] {PAWN_nameDef} asked, very casually, how flammable "{AMBITION}" would be.
[trait:Bloodlust] {PAWN_nameDef} asked whether "{AMBITION}" would get anyone killed, and sounded hopeful.
[trait:TooSmart] {PAWN_nameDef} corrected {OTHER_nameDef}'s arithmetic twice, then {PAWN_possessive} own once.
[trait:Ascetic] {PAWN_nameDef} asked why anyone needed "{AMBITION}" when there was perfectly good floor to sleep on.
[old] {PAWN_nameDef} said {PAWN_pronoun} had seen three colonies try something like "{AMBITION}", and one of them was still standing.
[child] {PAWN_nameDef} asked if "{AMBITION}" would have a slide, and would not let it go.
[teen] {PAWN_nameDef} sighed loudly enough to make it clear "{AMBITION}" was beneath {PAWN_objective}, then asked three very sensible questions about it.
[doubtful|bitter] {PAWN_nameDef} said {PAWN_pronoun}'d believe in "{AMBITION}" when {PAWN_pronoun} saw it, and not a day before.

warm.li: {PAWN_nameDef} squeezed {OTHER_nameDef}'s shoulder after the pitch and said it was a good idea, whatever the vote said.
{PAWN_nameDef} offered to help with "{AMBITION}" however the vote went.
{PAWN_nameDef} asked {OTHER_nameDef} a gentle question about "{AMBITION}" that turned out to have no good answer, and looked sorry about it.

blunt.li: {PAWN_nameDef} asked {OTHER_nameDef} whether {OTHER_pronoun} planned to lift a finger for "{AMBITION}", or just point at things.
{PAWN_nameDef} laughed out loud at "{AMBITION}", and not kindly.
{PAWN_nameDef} called "{AMBITION}" a waste of good stone and a whole season.
{PAWN_nameDef} told {OTHER_nameDef} to sit down before the pitch was half over.

cheerful.li: {PAWN_nameDef} started clapping halfway through {OTHER_nameDef}'s pitch for "{AMBITION}" and had to be asked to stop.
{PAWN_nameDef} volunteered for "{AMBITION}" before anyone had explained what it involved.
{PAWN_nameDef} raised {PAWN_possessive} cup to "{AMBITION}", though it was empty.

gloomy.li: {PAWN_nameDef} said "{AMBITION}" was a fine idea, the sort of thing they'd carve on the colony's grave marker.
{PAWN_nameDef} asked how many of them would still be alive to enjoy "{AMBITION}".
{PAWN_nameDef} stared at the floor through the whole of {OTHER_nameDef}'s pitch, and at the end said only "Hm."

cold.li: {PAWN_nameDef} asked {OTHER_nameDef} to put numbers on "{AMBITION}": hours of work, materials used, deaths prevented.
{PAWN_nameDef} listened to "{AMBITION}" without blinking, then asked who would be held responsible if it failed.
{PAWN_nameDef} observed that {OTHER_nameDef}'s proposals always seemed to benefit {OTHER_objective} most, and asked that this be noted.

plain.li: Put my name next to {OTHER_nameDef}'s on this one.
{OTHER_nameDef} said it first, but I've been thinking it for weeks.
Count me in on "{WISH}"; it isn't just {OTHER_nameDef} who wants it.
Add me to that; I've wanted the same for a while.
[trigger:raid] I was on the line next to {OTHER_nameDef} in that raid, and I'm asking too.
[trigger:floor] I ate my dinner off my knees as well, so add me to the list.
[trigger:rawfood|trigger:sick] My stomach agrees with {OTHER_nameDef}, loudly, and all night.
[trigger:cabin] I've been staring at the same four walls as {OTHER_nameDef}, so yes, me too.
[trigger:death] I knew them too, and I want to be standing at that grave with {OTHER_nameDef}.
[promised] It's already promised to {OTHER_nameDef}, so I'm only adding my name to it.
[repeat] {OTHER_nameDef} has asked more than once, and this time not alone.
[old] I wanted this before {OTHER_nameDef} ever got here, but I never said so.
[newcomer] I'm new, so maybe it isn't my place, but {OTHER_nameDef} is right.
[child] Me too, and {OTHER_nameDef} said I was allowed to ask!
[trait:Jealous] If {OTHER_nameDef} gets it, I want it too, so I'm asking now instead of sulking later.
[trait:Greedy] If {OTHER_nameDef}'s getting it, I want my share written in from the start.
I'll stand with {OTHER_nameDef} on this one.
{OTHER_nameDef} speaks for me too, on "{WISH}".
Same goes for me, whatever {OTHER_nameDef} asked for.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} shouldn't have to ask alone, so I'm asking too.
I'd been meaning to say something, and {OTHER_nameDef} was braver about it than me.
[trigger:death] Whatever {OTHER_nameDef} needs to say goodbye properly, I need it too.
I'll ask alongside {OTHER_nameDef}, because it matters to both of us.
If it helps {OTHER_nameDef} get it, put my name down too.

blunt.li: What {OTHER_nameDef} said, except I'm not saying please.
{OTHER_nameDef} is right, which I hate, so let's get it done before I change my mind.
[trigger:raid] I nearly died in that raid too, so yes, I'm with {OTHER_nameDef}.
Me too. Write it down.
Add me, and get on with it.

cheerful.li: Me too, me too, put me down twice if that's allowed!
{OTHER_nameDef} had a great idea, and I want my name on it too!
A petition, how official, I'm signing it with a flourish!
Count me in, the more of us the better!
Two voices are louder than one, so here's mine!

gloomy.li: I'll ask too, for all the good it'll do either of us.
One more voice, for whatever that's worth around here.
[bitter] They never listen to me, but maybe they'll listen to {OTHER_nameDef}.
Add my name, though I don't expect it'll change anything.
I'll sign, since {OTHER_nameDef} seems to think it's worth trying.

cold.li: Supporting {OTHER_nameDef} costs me nothing and doubles the pressure, so count me in.
{OTHER_nameDef}'s request benefits me as well, so I'm adding my weight to it.
[promised] This was promised to {OTHER_nameDef}, and I'll be watching what that promise is worth.
A request with two names on it is harder to ignore, so add mine.
I'll put my name to it, since it serves my interests too.
